nameEn: Manufacture of corrugated paper and paperboard and of containers of paper and paperboard
description: This class includes the manufacture of corrugated paper and paperboard and containers made from paper and paperboard.
includes: manufacture of corrugated paper and paperboard
manufacture of containers of corrugated paper and paperboard: boxes, cartons, cases
manufacture of fibre drums, cans and similar containers of paper and paperboard
manufacture of multiwall paper bags and sacks
excludes: manufacture of pulp, paper and paperboard, see 1701
